title: BASHAR - What is the HIGHER SELF - HIGHER MIND?
author: QUANTUM HEALING PATH
opening_summary: Bashar explains the personality structure and relationship between the physical mind and higher self. When Spirit creates a template for physical reality experience, it simultaneously creates a duality: the physical mind and a corresponding higher mind template. Every person is a complete whole composed of these two aspects. The higher mind acts as a liaison between the physical mind and higher soul levels, remaining mostly at the template/reality level. Like an individual on a boat supporting a diver below, the higher mind continuously sends information and guidance to the physical mind, which must become a sensitive enough receiver to interpret these messages aligned with one's highest excitement.

quotes.quote: Imagination is the conduit between your higher mind and your physical mind
The higher mind stands on the mountaintop and can see all pathways
Follow your passion, the vibration of excitement functions like a compass needle
Physical mind is designed to perceive how things happened, not how they will
The higher self conceives, physical brain receives, physical mind perceives
Your higher mind has its own world, realm with multi-dimensional time experience
When you let go of luggage not yours, things accelerate and flow faster

notes: Re-upload/clip channel (QUANTUM HEALING PATH), not official. Classic higher mind / physical mind teaching monologue (~4.2k words); includes the 'diver and boat' and 'mountaintop' metaphors and the 'conceive/receive/perceive' formulation.
